name: After Hours
tagline: 50 open-edition lo-fi stills for the night that never clocks out.
description: After Hours is a 50-piece open edition of lo-fi rooms. Each piece is its own unlimited ERC-1155: rain on glass, desk lamps, last trains, and the kind of quiet you can mint forever.

pieces.name: Tape Hiss, 2:14 AM
pieces.blurb: A sleeping cat, a warm tuner, and rain writing on the glass. The tape has been looping since yesterday.

pieces.name: Last Train Window
pieces.blurb: The last car heading out of town. City lights smear into the rain and nobody claims the backpack.

pieces.name: Convenience Fog
pieces.blurb: Fog against the automatic doors. The coffee is still too hot and the magazines have nobody to sell to.

pieces.name: Vinyl Basement
pieces.blurb: Crates of records under a single warm bulb. The turntable is still spinning something you almost remember.

pieces.name: Laundry on the Roof
pieces.blurb: Sheets becoming flags. The city is a quiet instrument under the clotheslines.

pieces.name: Closing Time Pour
pieces.blurb: Chairs already up. One cup left on the wood, rain rehearsing on the window.

pieces.name: The Quiet Tank
pieces.blurb: The only conversation left is bubbles. The rest of the apartment has gone dark on purpose.

pieces.name: Desk Lamp Botany
pieces.blurb: Notes, tea, and a plant that has outgrown the assignment. The street outside is already asleep.

pieces.name: Night Spin Cycle
pieces.blurb: One machine still working. The rest of the night is a circle of glass and suds.

pieces.name: Empty High Score
pieces.blurb: The high scores are still glowing for nobody. Coins sleep in the slots.

pieces.name: Steam and Street Neon
pieces.blurb: Mirror gone. The street is a pink smear through steam and an open window.

pieces.name: After Encore Booth
pieces.blurb: The song list is still lit. Nobody is brave enough for one more.

pieces.name: Second Floor Stacks
pieces.blurb: A green lamp keeping watch over towers of paper. Rain on the dormer like page turns.

pieces.name: Fire Escape Tea
pieces.blurb: Two cups, wet steel, and the building breathing through other people's lights.

pieces.name: Attic Frequency
pieces.blurb: Boxes of cassettes and a deck that still believes in VU meters. Moths keep the beat.

pieces.name: Snow at the Shelter
pieces.blurb: The last bus is a rumor. Snow edits the timetable into white.

pieces.name: Glasshouse After Dark
pieces.blurb: Tropical leaves holding the day's heat. Condensation turning the moon into a smear.

pieces.name: Red Light Studio
pieces.blurb: Foam walls, a live mic, and a red lamp that forgot to go off. The mix is still warming up.

pieces.name: Instant Noodle Hour
pieces.blurb: The only recipe that still works after midnight. A tiny TV snows on the counter.

pieces.name: Reserved Forever
pieces.blurb: The reading room after closing. One chair still reserved for a person who became a rumor.

pieces.name: Level P3 Wind
pieces.blurb: Wind across the top deck. The skyline does the talking; the car is just visiting.

pieces.name: Boardwalk Closed
pieces.blurb: Shutters down, ocean loud. The lights stayed on as a courtesy to nobody.

pieces.name: Hallway Ice Machine
pieces.blurb: Patterned carpet going on forever. The ice machine is the hallway's only heartbeat.

pieces.name: Alley Vending Glow
pieces.blurb: A row of machines selling cold light. The cat already chose a flavor.

pieces.name: Window Booth Special
pieces.blurb: The booth by the rain. Chrome, pie, and a clock that only tells neon.

pieces.name: Channel Snow
pieces.blurb: Every channel is weather. VHS spines watch the storm from the floor.

pieces.name: Twelve Plants, One Window
pieces.blurb: A window that became a forest. The city is only allowed in as speckles.

pieces.name: Platform 7
pieces.blurb: Tiles, a yellow line, and a light that might be a train. The bench is practicing patience.

pieces.name: Unfinished Sketch
pieces.blurb: A city half-drawn, ink still open. Polaroids of streets that already forgot their names.

pieces.name: Dashboard Rain
pieces.blurb: Engine off, radio not. Rain on the windshield is the music video.

pieces.name: Shrine After Rain
pieces.blurb: Lanterns still doing their job. Gravel shining, maple dripping, one umbrella off duty.

pieces.name: Dial-Up Midnight
pieces.blurb: A whole room of machines dreaming in color. Energy drinks keeping the chairs warm.

pieces.name: Wrapped Bouquets
pieces.blurb: The shutter is halfway down. Flowers that didn't get adopted wait in paper coats.

pieces.name: Courtyard Frequencies
pieces.blurb: Laundry, citrus pots, and a radio playing for the whole building whether they asked or not.

pieces.name: Practice Room C
pieces.blurb: The metronome is still. Sheet music stacked like unsent letters.

pieces.name: Tunnel of Fish
pieces.blurb: After the last ticket. Fish commute overhead and the floor keeps rewriting light.

pieces.name: Polaroid Wall
pieces.blurb: A wall of nights already developed. The blinds slice the street into film stills.

pieces.name: Coin Slot Storm
pieces.blurb: A glass room built for weather. The receiver dangles like it almost had news.

pieces.name: Cabin Glass
pieces.blurb: Snow pines pressed to the glass. Inside, a stove and a record that knows how to last.

pieces.name: Gate B12
pieces.blurb: The terminal practicing emptiness. A plane parked like a sleeping animal beyond the glass.

pieces.name: Awning and Two Wheels
pieces.blurb: A bike waiting out the weather. The awning does what roofs do, only smaller.

pieces.name: Projector Dust
pieces.blurb: A movie with no actors, only dust. Floor cushions facing a rectangle of warmth.

pieces.name: Striped Pole Neon
pieces.blurb: Mirrors rehearsing neon. The pole still spinning for a street with no haircuts left.

pieces.name: Dormitory Desk
pieces.blurb: Textbooks in a pile that counts as architecture. The lofted bed is a second sky.

pieces.name: Indoor Night Pool
pieces.blurb: Water holding the lights still. Outside the glass wall, the real weather keeps working.

pieces.name: On Air, Off Clock
pieces.blurb: The city through blinds, a board of sliders, and a lamp that means someone is still talking.

pieces.name: Stall 19 Packing Up
pieces.blurb: Tarps folding, lanterns lingering. The market turning back into a street.

pieces.name: Last Cat Asleep
pieces.blurb: Cups empty, cats clocked out. Rain making the window the best seat in the house.

pieces.name: Observatory Tea
pieces.blurb: A dome cracked open for the sky. Two cups, one thermos, infinite internight.

pieces.name: After the Bath
pieces.blurb: Lockers and leftover steam. Somewhere past the noren, the water is still loud.
